roadmapTask: Horizon 2 of the llm-http-proxy project (horizon 1 shipped the standalone package: scaffold, interceptor-core, provider-parser, payload-redaction, pluggable-logger). This horizon fixes the seven correctness code-review findings on the package (#1 derived-URL scheme, #2 token redaction, #3 emission-path crash guard, #4 reflectCall encoding, #5 redaction-walk DAG, #6 double-emit, #7 multibyte chunk buffering), each with a failing-before/passing-after regression test in the existing Jest *.test.ts files, keeping pnpm lint / typecheck / test / build green at package and repo-root level with no public API change.
